verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms an official Python SDK published on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2), alongside the official nitropy CLI. That gives developers a first-party library for integrating the key into desktop apps, and a community user praises Nitrokey's dev tools and documentation. Nothing in the pack shows SDK documentation, supported languages beyond Python, or any mobile (Android/iOS) SDK. Missing for 10: mobile SDKs, SDK API documentation, multi-language desktop SDKs, hands-on corroboration of app integration via the SDK.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs let me integrate the key into my own desktop and mobile apps

citations.quote: The official Python SDK also resolves on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2).
dev tools and documentation are top notch
